blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines– The 2026-27 NBA season continued Tuesday, November 24 (Monday, November 23 US time) with Trail Blazers handing the 76ers just their fourth loss, while the Grizzlies, Pacers, Timberwolves, Bucks, Suns, Bulls, Rockets, Spurs and Lakers also prevailed. Portland Trail Blazers beat Philadelphia 76ers, 128-111 Deni Avdija scored 31 points and made five 3-pointers to lead Portland, which finished with 19 3s. Donovan Clingan had 15 points and 18 rebounds, while Damian Lillard and Jrue Holiday added 18 points apiece. Holiday made four 3-pointers.
